reviews.t: Clear the toxins
reviews.x: I think this product works well as a complex face treatment. I use it every other day with night time moisturizer. My skin feels soft, moist and seemingly more youthful in the morning. I think it is important that we deliver nutrients to our face both externally and internally if we want to see great results and clear the toxins. Eating healthy is as important as this serum to our body (if what I am trying to say makes sense :)) Definitely worth buying and using as a part of face care regimen.

reviews.t: I'm vey happy with the results of this product
reviews.x: I was looking for something that would be natural because I'm prone to have allergic reactions to some products and this has not caused any reactions.  I use it twice a day with a moisturizer and it leaves my skin brighter and  seems to leave that glow you lose with aging skin. The bottle comes sealed with a spray applicator which I spray on my hand and then apply to face so you don't get in your eyes.  I'm vey happy with the results of this product.

reviews.t: love this!!

It goes on smooth with no residue and doesnt leave my face feeling greasy like some do. I have had people comment that my face looks brighter and less stressed. I attribute all this to the new product I just received.  I would recommend this to wverdyone!

reviews.t: Awesome product and It really helps!
reviews.x: I am a baby boomer and always want to keep myself mentally and physically younger.  This Vitamin C Serum really helps. I apply it to my face and neck in the morning and the evening for about 10 days, my skin looks younger, fresher, and softer.  I have to admit that I sometimes skip the moisturizer but still works great. Given the obvious result in the past, I will continue to order it and use it on a daily basis.

reviews.t: Definitely try it!
reviews.x: I have been searching for a "youth" serum to brighten, and soften my skin for sometime now.  I waited to review this product until I had it a couple weeks to test.  I am not sure if it is also supposed to clear blemished or that is just an added bonus!  My skin has never felt better, especially in this bitter cold.  I can't wait to see how much better my results get with continued use!

reviews.t: Love this product

The only thing I didn't like is that the liquid is messy.  It dispenses the liquid and it splashes everywhere... but I'm already used to it :-)  I would definitely recommend this product.

reviews.t: Highly recommended!

It absorbs in the skin very quickly and the citrus scent makes the skin instantly refreshed. In just two week, I can notice that my skin is much smoother and brighter than before. I will definitely going to continue this serum. Loved it!

reviews.t: Very pleased with what I'm seeing with this serum.

reviews.t: So refreshing! and you can feel it working. ...

reviews.t: Love this stuff
reviews.x: Love this stuff. I'm very picky with what I put on my dry adult acne prone face. This has significantly improved my complexion - smaller pores, minimal dryness, no acne. No wrinkles yet, but it really seems to plump me up so I imagine it would help there too.

reviews.t: Vitamin C Serum
reviews.x: This product is very good and is useful for for brightening and clarifying your skin. I would suggest to take your time before applying it on a daily basis if you are unaccustomed to using such products on your skin. I plan to re-purchase when I run out.

claims.text: Many reviewers report smoother, brighter, and more even-toned skin after regular use.
Reviewers frequently praise the lightweight, fast-absorbing formula that doesn't leave skin greasy.
Several reviewers mention the pleasant citrus/tangerine scent.
Some reviewers note the pump dispenses messily or squirts too hard.
A few reviewers report only slight or unclear results, especially for dark spots and fine lines.
